notes.title: Art Show & Tell: Share your Tilt Brush creations on Pluto
notes.content:
Have you been practicing your art skills by painting fantastical scenes in [b]Google Tilt Brush[/b]? Now it's easy to share your sketches with friends right away by using [b]Pluto[/b]. 

[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/plutovr/assets/Share+a+Tilt+Brush+File.png[/img]

First, make sure everyone who wants to participate is in the Pluto conversation and has Tilt Brush installed and running. 

[olist]
[*] Get into a Pluto conversation with a friend
[*] In Tilt Brush, save your sketch 
[*] Go to the Contacts tab on the Pluto dashboard
[*] Select the blue button next to the words "My Conversation"
[*] Navigate to the sketch that you want to share
[*] Tell the others in the conversation that you are sending a sketch (to alert them to save work in progress) 
[*] Share the sketch 
[*] When others select "Open," they will be surrounded by your sketch in Tilt Brush
[/olist]

[b]Here's what it looks like in action:[/b]

[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/plutovr/assets/Tilt+Brush+Sketch+Sharing+Button.png[/img]

[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/plutovr/assets/Tilt+Brush+Sketch+Sharing+2.png[/img]

[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/plutovr/assets/Tilt+Brush+Sketch+Sharing+3.png[/img]

notes.title: New Features: Notifications for Who's Online and Missed Calls; Better Status Indicators
notes.content:
Great feedback continues to come in (thank you!), and we’re excited about your part in helping us prioritize the following new Pluto features. Go check them out and let us know what you think.

[b]See When Your Contacts Come Online[/b]
Here’s a new way to stay informed about who’s available for a Pluto conversation. Now you’ll see a quick notification in the right lower corner of your desktop when a friend logs into Pluto. It will automatically disappear after a few seconds.  

[b]Missed Calls[/b]
Look for the round red circle at the upper left of a Pluto contact. If someone’s tried to reach you, the circle will appear and display the number of missed calls. Hover it over it with your pointer and you’ll see who called and when. Dismiss the circle by clicking on the white X that appears in the middle of the circle when you hover over it. 

[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/plutovr/assets/MissedCalls.jpg[/img]

[b]Better Available/Idle User Status[/b]
Your friends’ statuses now say "Available" when they’re actively using their computer, "Idle" when they have not been using it for 10 minutes or more, and "In VR" when they’re in the headset using VR. 

[b]Keep the Feedback Coming![/b]
Make sure to let us know if you encounter any issues that hinder or otherwise affect your Pluto experience. We’re always just an email away at support@plutovr.com, and we love hearing your thoughts!

notes.title: New Features: Names, Contacts, Account Tools
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! We’re getting a lot of excellent feedback on Pluto—thank you so much! Based on your comments, we’ve made the following changes to the service. Maybe you’ve noticed them? If not, please take a minute and check them out today. 

Let us know here or at support@plutovr.com if you have any blocking issues preventing you from enjoying your Pluto conversations. 

[b]Your Name[/b]
It’s time to get real! Now you can use your real name or something close to it as your display name. This makes it easier for your friends to find you in the Contacts directory. 

[b]Account Info[/b]
Quickly access your account details and reset your password or change your name on the new Pluto Account Info page.  

[b]Connect with Google Contacts[/b]
New feature: Import your Google contacts. Go to Add Contacts in Pluto and select "Sign in with Google" to see if any of your existing contacts already have Pluto accounts. If they do, they'll show up at the top of the list. If not, you can invite them here.

Once you sign in with Google when adding contacts, we'll notify you if any of your Google contacts later create a Pluto account, too! That way you can connect when you are both using VR, regardless of your physical location. 

[b]Better Contact Searching[/b]
Since you use Pluto with people you know, finding your contacts is essential to using and enjoying our service. Previously, you could only search by username and email, but now you can search by display name, too.  Even if you’re not sure of the exact name or spelling, Pluto will show you partial matches for the name you’re trying to find (email search still requires exact string). 

[b]Keep the feedback coming![/b]
Please share your thoughts with us anytime. We're interested in discovering more ways we can help you manage your Pluto account, use the service, and find your friends who are using VR!

notes.title: Welcome to Pluto!
notes.content:
[b] Thanks for trying out Pluto, the communications service for people in VR. Our purpose is to help humanity transcend physical location.[/b]

What can you do on Pluto? Make yourself available! 
[list] 
[*]First, add people to your contacts list, like friends, family, and professional contacts. 

[*]Start Pluto when you open Steam. 

[*]Leave it on when you're in VR and available to connect. 

[*]Then you and your friends can use Pluto to call each other anytime you want to chat face-to-face, meet up, or have a shared experience [/list]

[b] Tell us what you think![/b]

As an early Pluto customer, please let us know as soon as you encounter bugs, have questions, or would like to give us feedback about your Pluto experience. We're relying on you to help us make the service better, so send us your thoughts as often as possible. 

You can talk with us in the Steam discussion forums, on our Discord site at tinyurl dot com plutodiscord, or email us directly at support@plutovr.com.
